a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villagers propose avoiding needless cruelty while they remain uncertain about sentience.

a2.text: A farmer worries about obligations toward every broken tool.

b1.text: Researchers debate what observations might count as evidence of experience.

text_only.reason: "experience" in its everyday sense (what a person has lived through), not a skill gain

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A healer notes that failing to prove another mind exists does not prove it absent.

c1.text: An imagined being asks to choose its own work, unsettling the council.

c2.text: A skeptic says the words could be scripted; another asks whether that excuses ignoring them.
